info.name: Automation Anywhere API Task Execution AccessDetails Authentication API

items.docs: Authenticates a Control Room user using username and password or username and API key, and returns a JSON Web Token (JWT) for use in subsequent API calls. The token is valid for 20 minutes by default and must be included in the X-Authorization or Authorization header of all subsequent requests.

params.name: token
params.description: JWT token to validate (deprecated; use X-Authorization header instead)

items.docs: Verifies whether the provided JWT token is currently valid. Returns a boolean indicating validity. The token can be passed via the X-Authorization header or as a query parameter (deprecated).
Immediately invalidates the current JWT token, logging the user out of the Control Room API session. After calling this endpoint, the token can no longer be used for authenticated requests.
